review_scope: Saved frozen records only; no action selection, calibration refit, or new solver run.

calibration.scope: marginal over random calibration sample and a new exchangeable history under frozen mixture; not conditional risk for this realized threshold

p_value_scope: exact paired binary McNemar uses all 80 histories with failures coded no unique; other correlations/strata and multiple baseline p values are descriptive, no multiplicity adjustment
impedance_scope: RMSE of the fit of the known true candidate, not the selected model or deployable estimator
